_about: Jelly goo (the F02 pick, ported from research/sketches/lab-L4-jelly.html). Muzzy's Preset 2, 2026-10-17, plus the sketch's fixed values. Numbers only; keys starting with _ are notes.

_help.stiffness: How hard each jelly springs back to its grid shape. High = firm, fast jiggle; low = soft, slow sag.
_help.viscosity: Damping. Low = jiggles keep going; high = they die out fast.
_help.wobble: Size of the kicks when a jelly lands, rotates, merges, or pops.
_help.magnetism: Same-colour jellies reach for each other: reach 0.25 + 0.5 x this cells (up to ~1.75 cells at 3). Same scale as L3.
_help.tension: Sticky strings: how far they stretch before they snap, 0.35 + 0.75 x this cells (0 = none, 1 = about a cell, 3 = 2.6 cells). Same scale as L3.
_help.gravity: m/s2 (1 m = 10 cells): goo falling after a pop, hard drops.
_help.home: Fixed: home spring as a share of stiffness (keeps the body on its grid spot; also how much spinning sloshes it).
_help.corner: Fixed: corner rounding radius of the outline (cells).
_help.skin: Fixed: skin pull that rounds corners (off in the pick).
_help.unfilledAlpha: Filling goo: how see-through the not-yet-filled part is (1 = same as filled, 0 = invisible).
_help.unfilledDim: Filling goo: how much darker the not-yet-filled part is (0 = not darker).
_help.popMs: Pop drain length (ms). Placeholder until the laser look is designed.
